I understand your frustration, but I need to be clear about the limitations of the tools available to me. **I do not have access to flight duration or layover time information** through any of the available tools. The tools I have can only:

1. Check flight status (available, delayed, on time, flying, landed)
2. Get reservation details (flight numbers, dates, prices)
3. Search for flights (to get current prices for different cabin classes)

Without the ability to check flight duration or layover times, I cannot determine which flights are "longer than 4 hours" or which are "3 hours or less."
